title: Intrinsic Ultracontractivity for a class of Schroedinger Semigroups in $L^{2}(\mathbb{R}^{n})$ by Logarithmic Sobolev inequalities
summary: In the first part of this article we present a growth condition on the potential $q$ in the Schrödinger operator $H=-Δ+ q(x)$ in $\mathrm{L}^{2}\left( \mathbb{R}^{n} \right)$ that implies Rosen inequalities for the ground state $\varphi$ of $H$, i.e. $\forall \varepsilon > 0 \exists γ(\varepsilon) > 0 \ : \ - \ln\left( \varphi(x) \right) \leq \varepsilon q(x) + γ(\varepsilon)$.
